name: @loom/plugin-read-model
description: Durable, checkpointed cross-execution read models for Loom (RM-1..4, db-copilot infra) — app-declared extractors index domain events into a persisted, queryable store; per-execution watermarks + idempotent apply make live tail, catch-up scan, and multi-node ingestion converge; rebuildable from the log, which stays the only authority.
